description: This file contains unit tests for helper functions related to voice wake triggers and locale normalization in the OpenClaw project. It defines a struct 'VoiceWakeHelpersTests' with multiple test methods verifying behavior of functions like 'sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers' and 'normalizeLocaleIdentifier'.

classes.name: VoiceWakeHelpersTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for verifying voice wake trigger sanitation and locale normalization functionalities.

methods.name: sanitize triggers trims and drops empty
methods.description: Verifies that 'sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers' correctly trims whitespace and removes empty strings.

methods.name: sanitize triggers falls back to defaults
methods.description: Ensures the function returns default triggers when input contains only whitespace.

methods.name: sanitize triggers limits word length
methods.description: Checks that individual trigger words are limited to 'voiceWakeMaxWordLength'.

methods.name: sanitize triggers limits word count
methods.description: Verifies that the number of trigger words does not exceed 'voiceWakeMaxWords'.

methods.name: normalize locale strips collation
methods.description: Tests that locale identifiers with collation extensions are normalized by removing extensions.

methods.name: normalize locale strips unicode extensions
methods.description: Ensures that Unicode extensions in locale identifiers are removed during normalization.
